response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON a.translink = r.transreg COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, analysis_count * 1.0 / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL AND share > average_share
